research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Veza is researching generation of effective permissions from identity and access management policies, access privilege removal based on efficient access privilege usage monitoring, and automated and intelligent review of access decisions. It develops consistent rule based policy enforcement for access authorization, acceleration and deduplication of privilege graph traversal, enforcement of authorization rules across data environments, and a framework for pushing access privilege information from data environments. These efforts focus on authorization, privilege optimization, and graph based access modeling.

overview_description.description:
Veza is the data security platform that helps users use and share their data safely. It makes it easy to understand, manage, and control who can and should take what action on what data. It organizes authorization metadata across identity providers, data systems, cloud service providers, and applications, all to address the toughest data security challenges of the modern era.

The company is funded by top-tier investors including Accel, Bain Capital, Ballistic Ventures, Blackstone, GV, Norwest Venture Partners, and True Ventures.

about_short_description.short_description: Veza is a data security platform that helps users use and share their data safely.

product.name: Veza Access Platform
product.description: A unified identity security and access governance platform that maps identities, permissions, applications, infrastructure, and data to support visibility, authorization, reviews, and lifecycle management.

product.name: Veza Access Graph
product.description: A graph-based access analysis system that connects identities to effective permissions and shows who can take which actions on specific applications, systems, and data resources.

product.name: Veza Access AI
product.description: An AI-assisted identity security capability that uses natural-language interaction to search enterprise access relationships, identify risk, and support least-privilege and compliance decisions.

product.name: Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM)
product.description: A continuous identity-risk monitoring and governance capability for finding excessive privileges, dormant accounts, access drift, misconfigurations, and other weaknesses across cloud, SaaS, and hybrid environments.

product.name: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA)
product.description: A set of access governance capabilities for conducting risk-informed access reviews, managing identity lifecycles and requests, enforcing authorization policies, and evaluating separation-of-duties conflicts.

product.name: Non-Human Identity (NHI) Security
product.description: Security and governance for service accounts, machine identities, application identities, and other non-human principals, including visibility into ownership, permissions, usage, and privilege risk.
